captions.detailed: This 3D model features a rectangular word ring designed to span two fingers. The top face consists of a flat plate with a raised rectangular border, inside of which the letters "FAB" are extruded in a blocky, stylized font. On the underside, two circular ring bands project downwards, spaced apart to accommodate two fingers comfortably.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric two-finger word ring in OpenSCAD. The design should feature a customizable rectangular base plate with a raised frame border, custom extruded text inside the frame, and two finger rings on the underside with adjustable finger size and spacing.
captions.factory: The code uses a union block to combine the main components. The base plate is created by scaling a primitive cube. Custom text is rendered by extruding 2D polygons from the MCAD polyfont library using linear_extrude. The raised frame is constructed using a difference operation between two scaled cubes. Two finger bands are generated using difference operations on rotated cylinders, positioned on the underside of the plate, and cleaned up using the same subtraction cube as the frame.
